decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and cheap to keep, so the option remains open while demand uncertainty resolves.
The pegboard variant remains an incremental extension with low keeping costs, so the option is preserved.
The plain quarter-pallet display overlaps with adjustable and media-specific variants, making its option value low relative to the cost of keeping a redundant option.
The eighth-pallet size is a cheap, distinct variant and the option can be retained while demand is unresolved.
The wooden pallet is a larger step from core cardboard, but its distinctiveness and still-uncertain prospects justify keeping the option at acceptable cost.
The media-specific niche display has uncertain demand and low incremental keeping costs, so the option is held.
